measures.label: Projects
measures.definition: Every project record in any state.
measures.plain_rule: Every project record.

measures.label: Open projects
measures.definition: Projects not yet closed: Project Created, Active and On Hold.
measures.plain_rule: Projects whose current state is Project Created, Active or On Hold.
measures.blank_handling: Projects with a blank current state are not counted.

measures.label: Closed projects
measures.definition: Projects closed in any way (completed, dropped, cancelled…).
measures.plain_rule: Projects whose current state is anything other than Project Created, Active or On Hold.

measures.label: Projects in delivery
measures.definition: Projects actively being delivered (current state Active).
measures.plain_rule: Projects whose current state is Active. Project Created and On Hold are open but not in delivery.

measures.label: Projects on hold
measures.definition: Open projects currently paused.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose current state is On Hold.

measures.label: Projects not yet started
measures.definition: Open projects created but not yet started.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose current state is Project Created.

measures.label: Schedule risk
measures.definition: Open projects whose PM reports schedule Red or Amber.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose schedule KPI is Red or Amber (Yellow). A PM signal, distinct from overdue.

measures.label: Stale projects
measures.definition: Projects in delivery not edited for more than 30 days.
measures.plain_rule: Projects in delivery not modified for more than 30 days. Any edit resets this, so it is not a status-report compliance measure.

measures.label: Over-budget projects
measures.definition: Projects whose forecast (EAC) is above an approved budget; not spend.
measures.plain_rule: Projects whose forecast cost (EAC) is above the approved budget, where the budget is above 0. EAC is a forecast, not actual spend.
measures.blank_handling: A blank or zero budget is never over budget; a blank forecast is not flagged.

measures.label: Approved budget (USD)
measures.definition: Approved budget over open projects that have both a budget and a forecast.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of approved budget over open projects with a budget above 0 and a forecast of 0 or more.

measures.label: Forecast cost (EAC, USD)
measures.definition: Forecast at completion over the same projects; not actual spend.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of forecast cost (EAC) over the same comparable open projects. Not actual spend.

measures.label: Forecast variance (USD)
measures.definition: Forecast minus approved budget; negative is under budget.
measures.plain_rule: Forecast cost (EAC) minus approved budget over comparable open projects. Negative means under budget.

measures.label: Forecast variance (%)
measures.definition: Forecast variance as a percentage of approved budget.
measures.plain_rule: Forecast variance divided by approved budget, as a percentage (blank when the approved total is 0).

measures.label: Projects excluded from finance totals
measures.definition: Open projects left out of finance totals for lack of a budget or forecast.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects without a comparable budget and forecast (shown alongside the totals).

measures.label: Open demand requests
measures.definition: Requests still in the pipeline: New, Active, On Hold, Return to Requester.
measures.plain_rule: Requests in state New, Active, On Hold or Return to Requester.

measures.label: Overdue DOU gates
measures.definition: Open requests past the planned DOU date with no DOU issued.
measures.plain_rule: Open requests that need a DOU, whose planned DOU date is before the reporting date, with no DOU issued.

measures.label: Overdue DARB gates
measures.definition: Open, non-exempt requests past the DARB review date and not approved.
measures.plain_rule: Open, non-exempt requests whose DARB review date is before the reporting date and that are not yet approved.

measures.label: Overdue SOW gates
measures.definition: Open requests past the planned SOW date with no SOW issued.
measures.plain_rule: Open requests whose planned SOW date is before the reporting date with no SOW issued.

measures.label: Requests
measures.definition: Every demand request in any state.
measures.plain_rule: Every demand request.

measures.label: Reported Green (%)
measures.definition: Share of open projects whose PM reports Green; projects without a reported status are not counted.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects reported Green, as a share of open projects with a reported status. Not set is left out of the denominator.

measures.label: Reported Amber (%)
measures.definition: Share of open projects whose PM reports Amber; Not set is left out.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects reported Amber (Yellow), as a share of open projects with a reported status.

measures.label: Reported Red (%)
measures.definition: Share of open projects whose PM reports Red; Not set is left out.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects reported Red, as a share of open projects with a reported status.

measures.label: Reported status not set
measures.definition: Open projects whose PM has not reported a status.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects with no reported status. Shown as Not set, never as Green.

measures.label: Average calculated health
measures.definition: Mean of the 4-factor health score (schedule, cost, progress, issues) over open projects with enough data.
measures.plain_rule: Average calculated health score (0–100) of open projects with enough evidence (at least 60 % of the weight). Projects with insufficient data are left out.

measures.label: Calculated Green
measures.definition: Open projects scoring 75 or more on calculated health.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose calculated health is Green (score 75–100, no override).

measures.label: Calculated Amber
measures.definition: Open projects scoring 50–74 on calculated health.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose calculated health is Amber (score 50–74, or capped by a cost score of 25).

measures.label: Calculated Red
measures.definition: Open projects scoring below 50, or with a fatal schedule, cost or issues factor.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose calculated health is Red (score below 50, or a schedule, cost or issues score of 0).

measures.label: Insufficient data
measures.definition: Open projects without enough data to score health.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose health factors cover less than 60 % of the weight. Never counted as Green.

measures.label: Key priorities needing attention
measures.definition: Key priority projects with calculated Red or Amber health.
measures.plain_rule: Open key priority projects whose calculated health is Red or Amber.

measures.label: Median slip vs first baseline (days)
measures.definition: Typical number of days open projects have moved from their first baselined go-live.
measures.plain_rule: Median of planned deployment date minus first baselined date, over open projects with both dates. Positive means later than first planned.

measures.label: Average slip vs first baseline (days)
measures.definition: Average days open projects have moved from their first baselined go-live.
measures.plain_rule: Average of planned deployment date minus first baselined date, over open projects with both dates.

measures.label: Slip vs first baseline, 85th percentile (days)
measures.definition: Predictability — 85 % of open projects have slipped no more than this.
measures.plain_rule: The slip (planned minus first baselined date) that 85 % of open projects with both dates stay within.

measures.label: On hold more than 90 days
measures.definition: Projects on hold for more than 90 days.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects on hold whose hold started more than 90 days before the reporting date (candidates to restart or drop).

measures.label: Longest on hold (days)
measures.definition: Longest current hold, in days.
measures.plain_rule: Days from the hold date to the reporting date of the project on hold longest.

measures.label: Average time on hold (days)
measures.definition: Average length of current holds, in days.
measures.plain_rule: Average days from the hold date to the reporting date over projects on hold with a hold date.
measures.blank_handling: Projects on hold without a hold date are not counted (shown as not recorded).

measures.label: Past planning
measures.definition: Open projects that should have a baseline.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose lifecycle phase is past Planning (not Assign PM, TRB Review, Initiation or Planning, and set).

measures.label: Baselined
measures.definition: Projects past Planning with a recorded baseline.
measures.plain_rule: Projects past Planning that have a first baselined deployment date.

measures.label: Baselining compliance (%)
measures.definition: Share of projects past Planning that have a baseline.
measures.plain_rule: Baselined projects as a share of open projects past Planning.

measures.label: With a budget code
measures.definition: Projects with a budget code recorded.
measures.plain_rule: Projects in any state that carry a budget code (blank text counts as missing).

measures.label: Budget code compliance (%)
measures.definition: Share of all projects that carry a budget code.
measures.plain_rule: Projects with a budget code as a share of all projects.

measures.label: PM assigned
measures.definition: Projects in delivery that have a delivery manager.
measures.plain_rule: Projects in delivery with a delivery manager.

measures.label: PM assignment compliance (%)
measures.definition: Share of projects in delivery with a delivery manager.
measures.plain_rule: Projects in delivery with a delivery manager as a share of projects in delivery.

measures.label: Forecast more than 15 % over budget
measures.definition: Projects forecast to finish more than 15 % over their approved budget.
measures.plain_rule: Projects whose forecast cost (EAC) is more than 15 % above an approved budget above 0. EAC is a forecast, not actual spend.

measures.label: Net forecast vs budget (USD)
measures.definition: Total forecast above (+) or below (−) approved budget; not spend.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of forecast cost (EAC) minus approved budget over projects in any state with a budget above 0 and a forecast. Positive means forecast above budget.

measures.label: Forecast cost: internal (USD)
measures.definition: Internal part of forecast cost; not spend.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the internal component of forecast cost (EAC).

measures.label: Forecast cost: external (USD)
measures.definition: External part of forecast cost; not spend.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the external component of forecast cost (EAC).

measures.label: Forecast cost: contingency (USD)
measures.definition: Contingency part of forecast cost; not spend.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the contingency component of forecast cost (EAC).

measures.label: Forecast cost: hardware (USD)
measures.definition: Hardware part of forecast cost; not spend.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the hardware component of forecast cost (EAC).

measures.label: Forecast cost: software (USD)
measures.definition: Software part of forecast cost; not spend.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the software component of forecast cost (EAC).

measures.label: Project starts per month
measures.definition: Average monthly project starts over the last 12 months.
measures.plain_rule: Projects with an actual start date in the 12 months to the reporting date, divided by 12.

measures.label: Overdue governance actions
measures.definition: Gates past their planned date without sign-off.
measures.plain_rule: Overdue DOU, DARB and SOW gates on open requests, added up.

measures.label: Requests on hold more than 180 days
measures.definition: Requests on hold for more than 180 days.
measures.plain_rule: Requests on hold whose hold started more than 180 days before the reporting date.

measures.label: Longest request hold (days)
measures.definition: Longest current request hold, in days.
measures.plain_rule: Days from the hold date to the reporting date of the request on hold longest.

measures.label: Oldest open request (days)
measures.definition: Age of the oldest open request.
measures.plain_rule: Days from the oldest open request being raised to the reporting date.

measures.label: Estimated cost (USD)
measures.definition: Sum of request estimates; not spend.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the estimated cost recorded on requests. An estimate, not actual spend.

measures.label: Request approved budget (USD)
measures.definition: Budget approved on requests.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the approved budget recorded on requests.

measures.label: Requests with no budget yet
measures.definition: Requests without an approved budget.
measures.plain_rule: Requests whose approved budget is blank or 0.

measures.label: Approved for delivery
measures.definition: Requests approved to become projects.
measures.plain_rule: Requests in state Approved.

measures.label: Rejected or dropped
measures.definition: Requests closed without approval.
measures.plain_rule: Requests in state Rejected or Dropped.

measures.label: Converted requests
measures.definition: Requests that became projects.
measures.plain_rule: Requests that at least one project names as its originating request.

measures.label: Conversion rate (%)
measures.definition: Share of requests that became projects.
measures.plain_rule: Converted requests as a share of all requests.

measures.label: Average days to convert
measures.definition: Average days from request to project creation.
measures.plain_rule: Average days from a request being raised to its project being created, over converted requests (each project counts once).

measures.label: Discovery completed
measures.definition: Requests whose discovery stage has finished.
measures.plain_rule: Requests with a discovery actual end date and a planned end date.

measures.label: Discovery finished late
measures.definition: Discoveries that finished after plan.
measures.plain_rule: Completed discoveries whose actual end is after the planned end.

measures.label: Discovery finished early
measures.definition: Discoveries that finished before plan.
measures.plain_rule: Completed discoveries whose actual end is before the planned end.

measures.label: Discovery finished on time
measures.definition: Discoveries that finished on the planned day.
measures.plain_rule: Completed discoveries whose actual end equals the planned end.

measures.label: Internal effort (man-days)
measures.definition: Internal man-days estimated on requests.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the internal effort estimated on requests, in man-days.
measures.blank_handling: Requests without an estimate are counted as no estimate, not as 0.

measures.label: External effort (man-days)
measures.definition: External man-days estimated on requests.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the external effort estimated on requests, in man-days.

measures.label: SA/BA effort (man-days)
measures.definition: SA/BA man-days planned on requests.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the solution and business analysis effort planned on requests, in man-days.

measures.label: Requests with no effort estimate
measures.definition: Requests missing an effort estimate.
measures.plain_rule: Requests with neither an internal nor an external effort estimate.

measures.label: Estimated TCV of open projects
measures.definition: Estimated total contract value of the open projects.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the estimated total contract value of open projects (blank values are not counted).

measures.label: Open projects with a stage schedule
measures.definition: Open projects that have planned stage end dates.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects with at least one stage planned end date.

measures.label: Planning end passed
measures.definition: Open projects past the planned end of Planning.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose planning stage planned end is before the reporting date.

measures.label: Design end passed
measures.definition: Open projects past the planned end of Design.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose design stage planned end is before the reporting date.

measures.label: Build end passed
measures.definition: Open projects past the planned end of Build.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose build stage planned end is before the reporting date.

measures.label: Test end passed
measures.definition: Open projects past the planned end of Test.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose test stage planned end is before the reporting date.

measures.label: Implementation end passed
measures.definition: Open projects past the planned end of Implementation.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose implementation stage planned end is before the reporting date.

measures.label: Warranty end passed
measures.definition: Open projects past the planned end of Warranty and closure.
measures.plain_rule: Open projects whose warranty and closure stage planned end is before the reporting date.

measures.label: Completed projects
measures.definition: Projects delivered and completed.
measures.plain_rule: Projects whose current state is Completed.

measures.label: Closure approved
measures.definition: Completed projects with a formal closure approval.
measures.plain_rule: Completed projects whose closure approval is Approved.

measures.label: Closure compliance (%)
measures.definition: Share of completed projects with a formal closure approval.
measures.plain_rule: Completed projects with closure approved as a share of completed projects.

measures.label: Closure approval in progress
measures.definition: Projects waiting for closure approval.
measures.plain_rule: Projects in any state whose closure approval is in progress.

measures.label: Closure overdue
measures.definition: Completed projects past their planned closure without approval.
measures.plain_rule: DRAFT: completed projects without closure approval whose warranty and closure stage planned end is before the reporting date.

measures.label: Projects expected to report
measures.definition: Projects in delivery, which should send status reports.
measures.plain_rule: Projects in delivery (current state Active), each counted once.

measures.label: Reported in the last 30 days
measures.definition: Projects in delivery with a status report in the last 30 days.
measures.plain_rule: DRAFT: projects in delivery with at least one status report dated from 30 days before the reporting date up to the reporting date.

measures.label: Status reporting compliance (%)
measures.definition: Share of projects in delivery with a status report in the last 30 days.
measures.plain_rule: Projects in delivery that reported in the last 30 days as a share of projects in delivery.

measures.label: Status reports in the last 30 days
measures.definition: Status reports sent in the last 30 days.
measures.plain_rule: Status reports dated from 30 days before the reporting date up to the reporting date.

measures.label: Status reports
measures.definition: Status reports on record.
measures.plain_rule: Every status report record.

measures.label: Days since the latest report
measures.definition: Age in days of the most recent status report.
measures.plain_rule: Whole days from the most recent status report on or before the reporting date to the reporting date.

measures.label: PCRs
measures.definition: Project change requests on record, any approval stage.
measures.plain_rule: Every project change request (PCR), including initial-baseline PCRs.

measures.label: PCRs fully approved
measures.definition: PCRs with every approval given.
measures.plain_rule: PCRs whose approval is Fully Approved.

measures.label: PCRs awaiting approval
measures.definition: PCRs still in the approval flow.
measures.plain_rule: PCRs not yet fully approved and not rejected: Not Yet Requested, Approval In Progress, Requested By (RM) Approved, Delivery Manager Approved.

measures.label: PCRs rejected
measures.definition: PCRs rejected in approval.
measures.plain_rule: PCRs whose approval is Requested By (RM) Rejected.

measures.label: PCR approval (%)
measures.definition: Share of PCRs fully approved.
measures.plain_rule: Fully approved PCRs as a share of all PCRs.

measures.label: PCRs changing the go-live
measures.definition: PCRs that move the planned go-live date.
measures.plain_rule: PCRs that change the planned go-live date.

measures.label: Additional cost from PCRs
measures.definition: Cost PCRs add to the forecast; an estimate, not spend.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the additional cost recorded on PCRs (an estimate, not money spent).

measures.label: Projects with a PCR
measures.definition: Projects that have raised a PCR.
measures.plain_rule: Distinct projects with at least one PCR.

measures.label: Open risks
measures.definition: Risks not closed.
measures.plain_rule: Risks whose state is not Closed (a blank state counts as open).

measures.label: High-exposure risks
measures.definition: Open risks with exposure 15 or more.
measures.plain_rule: DRAFT: open risks with an exposure of 15 or more (likelihood × consequence).

measures.label: Cost exposure of open risks
measures.definition: What the open risks could cost if they happen; not spend.
measures.plain_rule: Sum of the cost exposure of open risks (an estimate of what a risk could cost).

measures.label: Risks past their due date
measures.definition: Open risks past their due date.
measures.plain_rule: Open risks whose due date is before the reporting date.

measures.label: Open issues
measures.definition: Issues not closed.
measures.plain_rule: Issues whose status is not Closed (a blank status counts as open).

measures.label: High-priority open issues
measures.definition: Open issues of high or critical priority.
measures.plain_rule: Open issues with priority High or Critical.

measures.label: Issues past their due date
measures.definition: Open issues past their due date.
measures.plain_rule: Open issues whose due date is before the reporting date.

measures.label: Open action items
measures.definition: Action items not completed.
measures.plain_rule: Action items whose state is not Completed (a blank state counts as open).

measures.label: Overdue action items
measures.definition: Open action items past their due date.
measures.plain_rule: Open action items whose due date is before the reporting date; due on the reporting date is not overdue.

measures.label: Open decisions
measures.definition: Decisions not yet completed.
measures.plain_rule: Decisions whose status is not Completed (a blank status counts as open).

measures.label: Hours logged
measures.definition: Hours logged and sent for approval or approved.
measures.plain_rule: Hours on timesheets that are Approved or Submitted (drafts and rejected lines are not counted).

measures.label: Hours approved
measures.definition: Hours on approved timesheets.
measures.plain_rule: Hours on Approved timesheets.

measures.label: Hours awaiting approval
measures.definition: Hours sent for approval and not yet approved.
measures.plain_rule: Hours on Submitted timesheets.

measures.label: Hours on timesheets
measures.definition: All hours entered, in any timesheet status.
measures.plain_rule: Hours on every timesheet line, in any status.

measures.label: People logging time
measures.definition: People who logged time.
measures.plain_rule: Distinct people with Approved or Submitted hours.

measures.label: Projects with time logged
measures.definition: Projects that have time logged.
measures.plain_rule: Distinct projects with Approved or Submitted hours.

measures.label: Projects with a task plan
measures.definition: Projects that have a task plan.
measures.plain_rule: Distinct projects with at least one task.

measures.label: Plan tasks
measures.definition: Tasks in project plans (summary rows left out).
measures.plain_rule: Tasks that are not summary rows.

measures.label: Open critical tasks
measures.definition: Unfinished tasks on the critical path.
measures.plain_rule: Tasks on the critical path, not summary rows, with progress below 100 % (blank progress counts as open).

measures.label: Late critical tasks
measures.definition: Unfinished critical tasks past their finish date.
measures.plain_rule: Open critical tasks whose finish date is before the reporting date; finishing on the reporting date is not late.

measures.label: Open requests with a budget code
measures.definition: Open requests with a budget code recorded.
measures.plain_rule: Open requests (New, Active, On Hold, Return to Requester) that carry a budget code (blank text counts as missing).

measures.label: Request budget code compliance (%)
measures.definition: Share of open requests that carry a budget code.
measures.plain_rule: Open requests with a budget code as a share of open requests.

measures.label: Open requests with a delivery manager
measures.definition: Open requests that have a delivery manager.
measures.plain_rule: Open requests with a delivery manager.

measures.label: Request PM assignment (%)
measures.definition: Share of open requests with a delivery manager.
measures.plain_rule: Open requests with a delivery manager as a share of open requests.

measures.label: Change requests
measures.definition: Requests raised as a change to an existing project.
measures.plain_rule: Requests marked as a change request (CR) to an existing project.

measures.label: CRs naming their project
measures.definition: Change requests with a master project recorded.
measures.plain_rule: Change requests that name the master project they change.

measures.label: Change request share (%)
measures.definition: Share of requests that are changes to existing projects.
measures.plain_rule: Change requests as a share of all requests.
